prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No effect was seen for home new_flow changes across 2 tests.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign across 2 tests, though 1 test made adoption worse and was stopped early.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, choose_path reorder, finish new_screen, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -3.4% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +8.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, notification] Sign In Push Notification Reminder: Adds a desktop system notification trigger when the sign-in window takes longer than usual or stalls. (why: 2 support emails reported that the sign-in screen fails to appear or stalls, and mean sign-in time is high at 567s.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In To Finish Phase: Moves the sign-in step to the end of onboarding right before the final home intro screen. (why: Sign-in currently drops off 20.7% of users early; letting users customize their pet first builds engagement before requiring account creation.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Overlay Setup Complete Screen: Adds a dedicated completion screen after home intro showing interactive shortcut cards for desktop pet controls. (why: Support receives multiple emails regarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet after finishing onboarding.)
3: [home, wait_info] Estimated Creation Time Counter: Displays an estimated time remaining indicator and tip carousel on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user uncertainty while rendering.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Speed Guidance Hint: Adds a reassuring hint on the path selection screen explaining that paths can be changed anytime in settings. (why: Choose path has an unusually high mean time (514s), indicating users hesitate over making the wrong permanent choice.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Account Persistence Safety Assurance Copy: Updates the headline and text on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in guarantees their pet will never be reset or lost. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [finish, layout] Home Intro Two Column Action Center: Changes the home intro screen layout to a two-column setup separating welcoming copy from control instructions. (why: Finish step dropoff is 35.2% and mean completion time is 5815s, with post-onboarding confusion around desktop pet controls.)

scores.note: Strong positive historical test result (+8%) and both funnel stalling data and support emails confirm the issue.
Reordering sign-in previously yielded negligible impact (-0.1%) and requires moderate structural changes.
Adding new finish screens previously hurt conversion (-6.7%) despite high user support feedback.
Addresses high wait times on home step, but home flow changes have historically shown little to no effect.
Simple copy hint targeting path hesitation; low cost with mild positive expectation.
Strong support email signal (8 emails) and config-only text change addressing user persistence fears.
High dropoff step with support backing, but layout redesigns in onboarding have consistently underperformed.
